children: Wisconsin community bank adopts Alkami's unified Platform to anticipate customer needs, deepen relationships, and drive future growth
PLANO, Texas, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) ("Alkami"), a

params.linkText: digital sales and service platform provider

children: for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced that

(Tri City), a community bank serving Southeastern Wisconsin for more than 60 years, is now live with the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform. The comprehensive suite includes Alkami's Onboarding & Account Opening Solution, Digital Banking Solution, and the Data & Marketing Solution.

, Tri City is bringing together account opening, digital banking, and data and marketing capabilities into one cohesive digital experience designed to help the bank onboard, engage, and grow customer relationships. The launch supports Tri City's commitment to delivering the personal, community-focused service its customers expect, while giving the bank the agility to adapt quickly to evolving digital expectations.

"At Tri City, community banking means meeting people where they are, whether they walk into a branch and someone knows them by name, or they choose to bank digitally," said Nick Bandoch, senior vice president and chief brand officer at Tri City. "Those everyday conversations that once happened naturally in the branch are happening differently now, and we need to be able to recognize customer needs and deliver relevant solutions in digital moments. We chose Alkami because its team is strategically focused on the digital experience and is agile enough to help us adapt faster, anticipate customer needs, and continue delivering the kind of personal service that has always defined Tri City."

As financial institutions look for ways to deepen relationships across every stage of the customer lifecycle, Alkami's unified Platform helps data-informed bankers turn insight into action. By combining onboarding and account opening, digital banking, and data and marketing capabilities, the Platform enables institutions like Tri City to create more connected experiences, identify opportunities earlier, and deliver timely, relevant engagement across digital channels.

"Tri City National Bank has built a strong legacy around hometown service and meaningful customer relationships," said Benjamin Conant, chief product officer at Alkami. "Through the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform, Tri City is extending that same relationship-driven approach into the digital channel. We are proud to support their vision and help them deliver experiences that are more connected, personalized, and responsive to the needs of their customers."
The launch gives Tri City a strong foundation for continuing to evolve its digital experience and deliver connected, relevant experiences as customer expectations change.
To learn more about Anticipatory Banking and the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform, visit here.

Alkami provides a digital sales and service platform for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.

About Tri City National Bank: Since 1963, Tri City National Bank has been helping families and business customers fulfill their financial dreams. Currently, Tri City National Bank operates 25 locations in Southeastern Wisconsin where it is known for unparalleled customer service. Tri City National Bank is Your Hometown Bank.
